The '''TX-3 combat flight suit''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] produced by [[Corellian Technologies/Legends|Corellian Technologies]]. Similar to the flight suits worn by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]]s, the TX-3 was widely used by the independent [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|Corellian Defense Force]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="Fortune" />

The fibers in the TX-3 provided protection from the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], extreme cold, and [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. It could also moderately protect the wearer from concussive and energy attacks. The TX-3 could provide [[Life support/Legends|life support]] for up to twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], and even longer if attached to an [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] supply. The flight suit cost between 3,000<ref name="Fortune" /> and 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="RPG-Core" />
